author: Scikit-Plots Learn
description: A generic workflow for separating ranking quality, threshold decisions, and probability calibration.
empty_message: No one has applied Validate probability outputs before using them for decisions to this topic yet.
instruction:
1. Confirm that the estimator output is intended to represent a probability.
2. Evaluate discrimination and calibration separately.
3. Use held-out or cross-validated predictions for calibration checks.
4. Inspect calibration curves and an appropriate probabilistic score.
5. Re-check after changes to the model, target prevalence, or deployment population.
6. State when available data is insufficient to support reliable probability claims.
title: Validate probability outputs before using them for decisions
